reading: Third-party extensions, which the merchant may enable, use or purchase (WC-S-0852), are the store's apps; M-067 holds them with Shopify's SH-C-156 and Salla's SA-C-194, both landed here.

A capability only WooCommerce shows so far: the connection of the store to its WooCommerce.com account, through which it installs extensions automatically, receives updates and support and manages subscriptions from the admin (WC-S-0899), with a settings section and an API group of its own (WC-S-0027, WC-S-0085). Its admin page WooCommerce > Extensions and its onboarding tasks are cited in the parent CM-APP-001 and in CM-APP-002, the same tree.

A join on role, a reading: the WooCommerce.com Marketplace, which connects developers and merchants (WC-S-0923), plays the role of Shopify's App Store and Salla's App Store (SH-S-2753, SA-S-1884); the terms differ (Marketplace, extensions, vendor). Strained: the Marketplace also sells themes (its category Themes, WC-S-0695, left uncited: domain E's, U-051), and its Vendor Agreement and 70% revenue share are cited in another tree, CM-PTN-001 and CM-PTN-003, as well as in CM-APP-003.
A capability only WooCommerce shows so far: the Marketplace's category Developed by Woo (WC-S-0697), with Automattic's Terms naming Woo extensions among Automattic's paid Services (WC-S-0644).

Webhooks that send the store's events to a URL (WC-S-0885), with topics and a REST resource; M-069 holds them with SH-C-162 and SA-C-192, both landed here. Its admin section is cited in the child CM-API-009.

The WooCommerce REST API, which connects the store to external systems (WC-S-0887); M-073 holds it with SH-C-171, landed here. Its keys, permissions, versions and caching are cited in the children CM-API-002, CM-API-003, CM-API-006 and CM-API-012, the same tree.

A join on role, a reading: WooCommerce's extension framework is how an extension adds its own pages and settings pages to the admin (wc_admin_register_page, woocommerce_get_settings_pages, WC-S-0450, WC-S-0444), the role of Shopify's App Home and Salla's Embedded SDK (SH-S-2182, SA-S-0197). Strained: the extension runs in the merchant's own install, not in an iframe or a platform-hosted extension, and the concern also holds what isn't admin UI: FeaturesUtil::declare_compatibility (WC-S-0455) and woocommerce_admin_rest_controllers (WC-S-0449), left uncited (notes); its integration settings are cited in CM-APP-010, the same tree.

WooCommerce's native support for MCP, through which AI assistants and tools interact with the store (WC-S-0918); M-079 holds it with SA-C-012, whose MCP keys (salla-mcp, SA-S-1725) are cited here and which landed in the parent CM-AIA-001.

A join on role, a reading: Automattic's Terms say it may offer features that use AI to help set up or operate the website or store (WC-S-0486), the role of Shopify's AI features in the admin (SH-S-7488) and Salla's released flag salla_gpt (SA-S-3400). Where WooCommerce's AI features sit, in the plugin or in an Automattic service, isn't stated.

A join on role, a reading: merchants find Woo Agency Partners in a directory and contact them from their profiles (WC-S-5497), the role of Shopify's Partner Directory and Salla's service providers on the partners platform (SH-S-0760, SA-S-0198). Strained: most of the concern is the Marketplace's category Business services and its subcategories (Insurance, Law, Finance and others, WC-S-0696, WC-S-0763 to WC-S-0772); whether their listings are partners' services or extensions isn't stated.
